==Acquisition ==
This skill is available while under the [[G.O.L.E.M. (disguise)|G.O.L.E.M. disguise]] during the [[April Fools' Day]] quest [[Annihilator 2: Searing Day]].

==Notes==
*This attack requires a [[weapon]] to work. Any weapon will do, but even with ranged weapons the attack will still hit in [[melee]] range.
